about: A skilled litigator with a proven track record, Jessica Wood focuses her practice on employment law, intellectual property and general civil litigation. With over 29 years of legal experience, she serves clients in Atlanta and throughout the state of Georgia. She is a shareholder at Bodker, Ramsey, Andrews, Winograd & Wildstein, P.C.
A committed and successful attorney, Ms. Wood has several awards and accolades. She was:
· Listed in the Georgia Trend Magazine’s Legal Elite list
· A recipient of the Distinguished Service Award, the Professionalism Award and the Outstanding Woman of Achievement Award by the Atlanta Bar Association
· Awarded the Kathleen Kessler Award, President's Award, and the Visionary Award by the Georgia Association for Women Lawyers.

Ms. Wood has been a member of many professional organizations, including the Atlanta Bar Association, Bleckley American Inn of Court, the Georgia Hispanic Bar Association, and the South Asian Bar Association of Georgia.

Ms. Wood received her Bachelor of Arts in journalism in 1983. She was a member of Alpha Xi Delta Fraternity and the Public Relations Society of America. In 1994, she received her Juris Doctor from the Georgia State University College of Law. During that time, she was a pupil of The Bleckley American Inn of Court.

First admitted to practice in Georgia in 1994, Ms. Wood is a member of the Supreme Court of the United States, the Supreme Court of Georgia, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia and the Georgia Court of Appeals.
